newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Basis remains mostly down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Basis remains mostly down.

text.p: Basis levels for dark northern spring wheat fell on Friday, but some dealers reported a slight pickup in movement sparked by early MGE wheat gains.
But in the Pacific Northwest, movement was limited.
MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed, with deferred months gaining on spillover support from CBOT and KCBT wheat after USDA's bullish winter wheat seedings report, traders said.

New crop futures in Kansas City and Chicago gained sharply after USDA estimated winter wheat seedings for the 1997 crop at 48.22 million acres, well below the average projection in a Reuters analysts survey of 51.40 million.
The USDA winter wheat seeding estimate was the lowest planted acreage since 1978.
Low U.S. winter wheat seedings could prompt more plantings of spring wheat later this year, Agriculture Department officials said Friday.
